title: Changes in corneal endothelial cells after trabeculectomy and EX-PRESS shunt: 2-year follow-up
indication: Glaucoma with uncontrolled IOP on maximum tolerated medical therapy (Table 1): trabeculectomy POAG 24, normal-tension 24, secondary 11, exfoliation 5; EX-PRESS POAG 30, normal-tension 12, secondary 8; with or without combined cataract surgery

groups.description: Fornix-based trabeculectomy with mitomycin C combined with phacoemulsification and IOL (superior one-site approach); single surgeon, Kagawa 2014-2016; prospective observational
Fornix-based trabeculectomy with mitomycin C alone
EX-PRESS P50 glaucoma filtration device under a scleral flap combined with phacoemulsification (2.4 mm temporal clear corneal incision) and IOL
EX-PRESS P50 glaucoma filtration device alone

notes: Role: trabeculectomy and EX-PRESS implantation are two established filtration procedures compared without an investigational agent; all four groups are control-role. Allocation was not random: the EX-PRESS procedure was used for eyes with previous vitreous surgery or severe vision loss in the fellow eye, and trabeculectomy eyes were age- and sex-matched from a larger series.
Combined-surgery subgroups are separate groups because the added cataract surgery changes the procedure; all keep the glaucoma context.
The abstract states 60 trabeculectomy eyes of 60 patients; Tables 1 and 3 count 64 (29 combined + 35 alone). Table 3 n are used.
